title: Waterwraith/Tyre complete lane on the approved native line (visual, policy, actor, register, combat, cleanup)

native.head: 923b9443b438c7af3b3a87df7e43d530b6590474
native.note: The 9 lane-31 commits replayed from the old Batch-E base (07f173ae) onto approved f14c6851, clean, no conflicts. Native origin/upstream not pushed.

shared_hooks_for_lane_01: CMakeLists.txt: the 6 pc_p2_waterwraith_* TUs build into a new STATIC library libp2_waterwraith_lane31.a, linked before pikmin_legacy. Reason: adding them directly to PC_PORT_SOURCES pushes the pikmin_pc link over the Windows command-line threshold, so CMake emits @CMakeFiles/pikmin_pc.rsp, which scripts/build_pikmin2_fixture.py fails closed on. If lane 01 prefers inline TUs, the fixture builder must gain response-file support.

pc_port/pc_p2_hardlanes.cpp: opt-in register seam hooks (include, reset/setup/update/draw), tagged 'Waterwraith (#443 / #175) - lane 31 additive hook'. No-op unless p2-waterwraith-actor.txt is present.
The register seam calls the family combat consumer and resets it on teardown.

markers: P2_WATERWRAITH_ENCOUNTER_PASS stuns=1 hits=39 crushes=20 damage=2340.0 zeroed=1 child_removed=1

limitations: The roller crush uses InteractFlick with the resident captain as the acting owner: the source attribution creature is absent on this host actor (retained-assembly Waterwraith attack callback out of scope). Tyre fp24 damage 10 and the radii are lane adaptations.
The host death script (dismount -> tyre_getoff -> child removal) and the body Dead key sequence are driven by encounter inputs; the retained-assembly pathfinder is not ported.

Purple Pikmin are real squad members converted with pc_p2_make_purple from the staged P2_PURPLE_1 profile (impact disabled) and positioned near the actor by the fixture; this is a live-squad arena, not a natural cave encounter.
Treasure released on Dead KEYEVENT_5 is logged only; durable reward/Onion is lane 06. The shared lane 10/11 receiver remains the production combat route.
